entities.name: Bluetooth radio disabled or in airplane mode
Device out of range (>10m) or obstructed
Peripheral battery low or not in pairing mode
Previous pairing profile corrupted or stale
Interference from other wireless devices (Wi-Fi, cordless phones)
Mouse cursor does not move or clicks are not registered
Keyboard keys produce no input or repeat erratically
Bluetooth headset shows as "Not connected" in Settings; microphone is silent in Teams or other apps
Could not connect to the device. Make sure the device is turned on and discoverable.
Ensure the laptop's Bluetooth radio is enabled
Make sure the peripheral is charged (or has fresh batteries) and is set to pairing mode
Open Bluetooth settings: Windows - Settings -> Bluetooth & devices; macOS - System Settings -> Bluetooth
Click "Add device" (Windows) or the "+" button (macOS) to start discovery
Put the peripheral into pairing mode
When the device appears in the list, select it and click "Connect" (Windows) or "Pair" (macOS)
If prompted, confirm the passkey on both the laptop and the peripheral
Wait
